definitions: The act of shortening something by cutting off the top or end.
The state of being shortened or cut off.
In mathematics, the process of limiting the number of digits to the right of the decimal point, or of terms in a series, by discarding the less significant ones.
In computer science, the reduction of a data string or number to a shorter length by removing characters or digits from one end.
examples: The truncation of the data led to some loss of information.
We observed the truncation of the signal.
The truncation of the list was necessary.
